text:
Tess B: Heads-up: we need a decision for the new multi-step datasource-wizard. Validation options debated: inline-per-field (on blur), step-level summary, or only final-submit gating. Also destructive actions (revoke creds / delete connector) can live in-step vs global. Thoughts? Omar Q: For multi-step I'd avoid final-only gating. Users expect step-level checks. My take: show soft inline hints while typing, validate on blur, and if they try to advance show a step summary if there are unresolved errors. Keep the forward button disabled until required fields in that step are valid. Lena V: Agree with step-level friction. But small screens + long wizards get annoying with persistent errors. Proposal: compact step header indicator + micro summary under header ("2 fixes") and only expand details on click. Keeps screen tidy. Tess B: Sounds reasonable. Edge case: some validations require cross-step knowledge (e.g., name uniqueness across all datasources). Do we validate those live or at final submit? Omar Q: Cross-step checks should run on advance and on final submit. If name already taken, show a non-blocking warning on the step where name is entered and prevent advance only if it's a hard conflict. Soft collision could be allowed with suggested suffix. UX: inline suggestion + quick "copy suggestion" action. Lena V: Destructive actions: for revoke creds inline in the connector step, use a modal confirm with short explanation and a checkbox "Also remove stored tokens". For global delete connector (irreversible), require typed-confirm anywhere in the app, not just inside wizard. Rationale: typed-confirm is heavy so keep it at global surface. Tess B: microcopy proposal for step banner: "This step has 1 issue review details" (collapsed). On expand show fields, inline errors. For name conflict suggestion: "Name already in use. Try \"my-name-1\"" with a quick replace button. Omar Q: Accessibility checklist: - Step banner should be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, not just text. - When expanding details, move focus into the details region and set aria-live="polite" for the message count. - When disabling Next, set aria-disabled and include tooltip explaining required fixes. Lena V: Example snippet to include in spec: ```html
2 form errors
Name must be unique across datasources.
``` Tess B: Voting: thumbs up if we land on: step-level validation (blur->show), collapsed step summaries, cross-step hard checks on advance, soft suggestions live, inline revoke modal, typed-confirm for global irreversible deletes. :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:. Omar Q: :thumbsup: Lena V: :thumbsup: small ask: add an animation when expanding details and ensure focus-visible ring is prominent for keyboard users. DesignBot: lint: wizard prototype /design/prototypes/datasource-wizard shows missing aria-expanded on step headers and two inputs without aria-describedby. Logged issues. Tess B: Great I'll update the spec, add the microcopy + code snippets to Figma, and open a PR with an a11y checklist. I'll also add the suggestion replace action as a small UX pattern. DesignBot: spec PR created: #629. Checklist added to /design/specs/wizard-validation.
